mattermost.title: Mattermost
mattermost.episode_notes: The miss is a model error, not a replay error: on `qa-01` the model called a tool named `get_users_teams_threads_by_uid_uid_3`, which does not exist (the three-parameter route is `get_users_teams_threads_by_uid_uid_2_uid`), the provider rejected the call with a 400 and the episode ended without an answer. Generated names for routes with several same-rule parameters are the hard part of this environment.
